snippet.title: Subway Surfers City | Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 ​Pre-register now: https://subwaysurferscity.sng.link/Dv4d0/ntk1
🗓️ ​Launching Feb 26

Time to gear up! 🏙️​

Be part of the movement and join the crew as the journey expands into Subway City on February 26th!

Subway Surfers City is a new way to experience the universe — featuring stunning visuals, handcrafted challenges, and new gameplay mechanics and modes that bring fresh energy to every run.

More ways to play. More ways to be part of it.

#SubwaySurfersCity #subwaysurfers #TimeToGearUp
